snapshot.title: Don't treat user-started tasks as abandoned
snapshot.description: If the user sets a task to in progress (the user can't claim), `next_task` immediately offers it to an agent as abandoned, with the "another agent started this task" warning. Decide the intended behavior before the GUI makes this easy, e.g. only treat a task as abandoned if an agent's claim ended on it, or let user-started tasks be skipped. Record the decision as a note.
